description: This file defines a custom ASP.NET Core MVC action filter called ValidatorActionFilter that validates model state before executing an action and returns validation errors in JSON format if invalid.

classes.name: ValidatorActionFilter
classes.description: A custom action filter implementing IActionFilter to validate model state and respond with errors if invalid.

methods.name: OnActionExecuting
methods.description: Checks if the model state is valid; if not, constructs a JSON response containing validation errors and sets the response status to 422.

methods.name: OnActionExecuted
methods.description: Empty method, provided as part of IActionFilter interface, no implementation needed after action execution.
